en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire, surrounded by compact town buildings. In the foreground and to the right are large detached villas with steep, gabled roofs and decorative timber framing, bordered by tree‑lined, winding paths and roads running through a park‑like area. The background shows rolling, wooded hills. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
